name: B10-0120/2026 (Renew) – Targeted expulsions of foreign journalists and foreign Christians in Türkiye under national security pretexts
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted expulsions of foreign journalists and foreign Christians in Türkiye under national security pretexts
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Türkiye to stop expelling foreign journalists and foreign Christians on vague national security grounds. It wants Türkiye to end the use of two secret security codes used to ban people without evidence or trial, release a detained Iranian journalist, and restore press credentials and residence permits. It also asks the European Commission to watch this in EU–Türkiye relations and asks EU countries to offer visas to those at risk.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament only asks Türkiye and the EU Commission to act.
- **Who it affects:** Foreign journalists and foreign Christians in Türkiye, plus their families.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU bodies and Türkiye; no binding steps follow.
